sentences.text: 1. Since this is a case under Sections 363, 366, 376 (3), 506 of IPC read with Section 4 (2)/6 of the POCSO Act, Mr. Arijeet Mishra, learned counsel for the petitioner is permitted to implead the informant, mother of the victim as opposite party No.2 in this case.
He shall file the consolidated cause title impleading the newly added opposite party as opposite party no.2 within three working days.
2. Issue notice to the newly added opposite party No.2 by registered post with A.D., requisites for which shall be filed within three working days.
The notice shall be made returnable within four weeks.

Mr. Mishra, learned counsel for the petitioner shall serve an extra copy of the brief alongwith consolidated cause title on learned counsel for the State within three days for sending the same to the informant through the IIC, Jarpada Police Station.

Government Advocate is directed to inform the concerned I.O./I.I.C.
to intimate the informant that the case is posted to 20.12.2023 and in case she cannot engage an advocate, she can appear through video conferencing mode from the police station on the next date Lipun Behera vs State Of Odisha And Another ..... ... on 14 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/77353967/
